snippet.title: Static Hour - Exclusive Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Static Hour is a 1980s newsroom thriller where you decide what goes on air during a mysterious lockdown. Uncover a story you can’t see but only hear, and choose which voices make it to air. Every broadcast pushes the town closer to the truth or deeper into panic.

Wishlist: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4910010/Static_Hour/
